agent: Codex parent with two read-only Strata audit workers (loader/call-graph, packer/test)
scope: Add direct IQ4_XS/IQ4_NL support to the MTP draft layer's dense runtime so a qualified Flash-Next MTP IQ4 candidate can be served without a Q8_0 requantization pass, and repack one such candidate into a Strata runtime directory. This change does NOT serve the candidate live: it adds no live speculative-acceptance or throughput measurement, and it does not change the default Q8_0 path.

why_this_format.question: Which low-bit target matches the MXFP4-trained candidate's bits-per-weight and transfers its quantization-aware training?
why_this_format.chosen: IQ4_XS for the 256-aligned projections, IQ4_NL for the 640-column shared-expert down projection
why_this_format.why_not_q4_0_or_k_quants: Q4_0 is 4.5 bpw but has no per-group sub-scales and lost 2.0 points of teacher agreement against the mixed IQ4 candidate; the K-quants and IQ3 arms lost 7.1 to 12.1 points. IQ4_XS keeps the MXFP4 grid's 4.25 bpw and retains 98.68 percent of MXFP4's absolute teacher-logit gain.

runtime.contract: The dense manifest's kind column may now name iq4_xs or iq4_nl beside q8_0, bf16 and f32. MtpDrafter::wq returns the tensor's own GGML type and a pointer into dense.bin, so the projection runs through the existing native MMVQ dispatch (IQ4_XS=23, IQ4_NL=20) with no new kernel.
runtime.validation: mtp_format::validate rejects an unknown kind, a duplicate name, a row/column/block misalignment, a byte count that disagrees with the format, a pointer that is not 4-byte aligned (the MMVQ contract's own requirement, not the 256-byte stride the packer writes), and a range outside dense.bin, all before the device upload.
runtime.backward_compatibility: The old --mtp-q4 Q4_0 copy path and every Q8_0 runtime are unchanged; a Q8_0-only runtime still loads and still serves.
runtime.prefill_boundary: Prefill::draft_kv reads the drafter's Q8_0 tensors directly (tensor_q8). With an IQ4 runtime it declines that path and the drafter's own pass computes the prompt K/V instead. This is a stated behavioural difference, not a silent one.

inputs: a GGML safetensors candidate with module_formats metadata
outputs: a new runtime directory with a rewritten dense.txt/dense.bin
mtp-iq4xs-receipt.json with the candidate, base and output SHA-256 digests
packer.fused_gr_handling: The eight trained fused-GR modules are not MMVQ projections; Strata reads them as BF16. The packer dequantizes the candidate's IQ4 blocks with the GGML IQ4 decode and rounds them to BF16 (--gr dequantize-bf16, the default), or keeps the base runtime's GR weights (--gr preserve-base). A candidate with a partial GR set is refused rather than silently half-applied.
packer.preserved: experts.bin, draft_vocab.bin, the norm and router tensors, and the untouched projection bytes are copied byte-for-byte; the repacked experts.bin was compared byte-for-byte with the base.
packer.dependencies: Python standard library plus numpy only; no safetensors package is required.

tests: the mtp-iq4xs-packer check added to just quality

decoder_bit_exactness.claim: The packer's IQ4_XS and IQ4_NL decoders are bit-exact against the same local libggml-base that produced the candidate.
decoder_bit_exactness.method: dequantize_row_iq4_xs and dequantize_row_iq4_nl called through ctypes on the candidate's own blocks; the float32 bit patterns were compared.
decoder_bit_exactness.result: identical bit patterns on all three

teacher_logit_agreement.claim: The Strata serving approximation of the candidate (ten IQ4 projections plus the eight trained GR modules dequantized to BF16) keeps the MXFP4-trained candidate's quality.
teacher_logit_agreement.protocol: 2,044 group-disjoint held-out pairs from four private banks, FP16 with SDPA attention on MPS, the same harness as the format-selection campaign; base, MXFP4 and candidate measured in one run.
teacher_logit_agreement.interpretation: The candidate is statistically indistinguishable from the MXFP4 grid it was trained on (44 wins, 54 losses, 1,946 ties, p=0.36) and far above the base (p=1.5e-174). The BF16 rounding of the GR modules is the only approximation in this configuration.

phase_one_only.claim: Quantizing only the ten MMVQ projections and leaving the GR modules at base weights still recovers most of the gain, so the two stages can be sequenced.
phase_one_only.note: This arm evaluates BASE GR weights, so it is not the serving configuration; it only bounds the first stage.

runtime_size.note: The dense projection blob shrinks from 110.7 MiB to 75.6 MiB. experts.bin (675 MiB) and the routed experts are untouched.

checks.result: aggregate_passed true; the new mtp-iq4xs-packer check and Ruff on the two new files ran inside it

b550.role: compile-only build host for this change

main.role: repository gate, packer, decoder proof, teacher-logit evaluation

non_claims: No live Strata serve ran with the IQ4 runtime: both B550 GPUs were occupied by unrelated work (an llama-imatrix process on GPU 0 at 22.4 GiB and a retrieval trainer on GPU 1 at 21.6 GiB), so no speculative acceptance, no draft quality, and no throughput number is claimed.
The teacher-logit evaluation measures agreement with the teacher on one private bank set, not speculative acceptance, and it evaluates the model's arithmetic, not the CUDA MMVQ kernels' numerics.
The BF16 rounding of the eight fused-GR modules is an approximation of the trained candidate; a direct low-bit fused-GR kernel is not implemented and is not claimed.

The IQ4 blocks were produced by the external GGML quantizer and are assumed to be byte-compatible with Strata's IQ4_XS/IQ4_NL kernels; the decoder path was proven bit-exact, but a kernel-level parity test on the real artifact has not run.
The repacked runtime directory lives in the ignored build tree and is not a published artifact.
The candidate was produced by a separate campaign in RESMP-DEV/mlx-stack; this change only consumes it.
